title: Prime localization classifies valuation overrings
statement: Let $F$ be a field and $V\subseteq F$ a valuation ring with fraction field $F$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. The assignment $\mathfrak p\mapsto V_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], with localization viewed as a subring of $F$, is an order-reversing bijection between prime ideals of $V$ and valuation subrings $A$ of $F$ containing $V$. The inverse sends $A$ to $\mathfrak m_A\cap V$, where $\mathfrak m_A$ is its maximal ideal.

source.place: Section 2.1, printed p. 7, paragraph beginning “Any ring A” and the displayed description of the corresponding prime ideal. Author’s v3 PDF read online; local archive WANTED.
